name: Hepi v0.10.1
body:
- Added window opacity shortcuts: Ctrl+[ and Ctrl+]
- Updated Sidekick to allow changing window opacity
- Fixed Windows Defender automatically removing app
- Fixed bugs and improved stability

name: Hepi v0.10.0
body:
- Added setting hide screenshot selection
- Fixed screen capture selection not closing
- Removed Lockdown Guard to avoid errors

name: Hepi v0.9.9
body:
- Added SEB Lock Screen Block feature
- Fixed bugs and strengthened security

name: Hepi v0.9.8
body:
- Added SEB Clipboard Restore (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V) feature, allowing copying content from SEB to Hepi and vice versa
- Improved quiz response speed (Quiz Tab) and enhanced AI stability
- Improved the guide experience when opening SEB

name: Hepi v0.9.7
body:
- Added settings backup and restore feature
- Show thinking in AI chat, with an option to enable/disable thinking in settings
- Fixed screenshot offset when display scaling is above 100%
- Lockdown Guard now automatically turns off when exiting Hepi
- Update Sidekick: Improved Sidekick stability. Supports shortcuts such as Insert, Home, PageUp, PageDown. Fixed select boxes disappearing when using screenshot capture

name: Hepi v0.9.6
body:
- Allow changing the AI model for chat and quiz in settings
- Fixed dropdowns disappearing because of the keep window on top feature
- Updated Hepi Sidekick: Allow adding multiple images when chatting, sending images without chat text, and displaying math formulas in AI responses

name: Hepi v0.9.4
body:
- Added a feature to prevent exam or monitoring software from changing the registry to lock down Windows functions such as Task Manager and Shutdown
- Fixed being unable to close SEB in isolated desktop mode

name: Hepi v0.9.3
body:
- Hepi can now run inside SEB's isolated desktop environment, with AI chat and quiz lookup directly inside SEB
- Automatically restores the SEB unlock state so you can return to the SEB desktop after a crash or accidental exit
- Added more customizable shortcuts: F4, Ctrl+Shift+C, Ctrl+Shift+V, and Ctrl+Shift+D
- Added guide when opening SEB
- Fix bugs and optimize application

name: Hepi v0.8.6
body:
- Fixed Meeting feature issues: Resolved the bug preventing the use of the Meeting feature (commonly used for interview bypass, online learning, etc.).
- Clipboard Image Support: You can now paste images directly from your clipboard into the chat box.
- Telex Toggle in Ghost Mode: Added the ability to disable Telex typing while in Ghost Mode (Press Ctrl+Y).
- Optimizations & Improvements: General performance enhancements and minor UI/UX refinements.
